name: paper_cutout
description: Turn an image into a torn-paper cutout, a PNG with alpha. The shape (mask) is printed on paper in two inks or its own colour, with an optional cream border and red sticker outline, then torn: a wandering edge with a white fibrous core and stray fibres, crumple and crease relief lit from the top left, grain, and a soft shadow down and to the right with a contact line. The PNG is cropped to the paper and its shadow. Every px parameter is measured after resizing to width. The same seed and parameters give the same bytes. Needs numpy (the rvm extra).

output.description: { path: the PNG with alpha, width, height } in px

params.name: mask
params.description: Which part of the image is the paper. alpha: its transparency (an image without any falls back to white). white: what is darker than thresh, for a shape on white. black: what is lighter than thresh, for a shape on black. ellipse: the ellipse filling the image. rect: the whole image.

params.name: thresh
params.description: Luminance that separates the shape from the background for white and black. Omit for 235 (white) or 25 (black).

params.name: width
params.description: The image is resized to this width in px first; the height follows its aspect.

params.name: halftone
params.description: Halftone dot pitch in px for the two-ink face. 0 is a continuous tone. Ignored with keep-color.

params.name: mono
params.description: Two inks, ink on cream paper. This is already the face whenever keep-color is off; keep-color wins over it.

params.name: keep-color
params.description: Keep the image's own colour, saturated by vivid, instead of two inks.

params.name: border
params.description: Cream paper border around the shape, in px. 0 tears the image itself.

params.name: outline
params.description: Red sticker outline outside the border, in px. 0 for none.

params.name: tear
params.description: How far the torn edge wanders, in px.

params.name: core
params.description: Width of the white fibrous core along the torn edge, in px.

params.name: crumple
params.description: Crumple and crease relief, from 0 (flat) to 1.

params.name: vivid
params.description: Saturation with keep-color: 1 keeps the image's, more is more vivid.

params.name: shadow
params.description: Shadow offset DX,DY in px, down and to the right (0 or more). 0,0 for no shadow.

params.name: crop
params.description: Crop the source first: x0,y0,x1,y1 in source px.

params.name: seed
params.description: Seed for the tear, fibres, creases and grain. Another seed gives another tear.

params.name: out
params.description: Output .png path. Default <input stem>_paper.png beside the input. Optional with _project: saved in the project's assets folder.
